answer: At a walnut market on the wharf, AI trading agents allocate auction slots by a lottery weighted by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days. Creating mirror identities gives an attacker no extra chance: splitting 100 tokens among 100 accounts earns the same total lottery weight as staking them in one account. To gain more influence, the attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying their purchase price and forgoing other uses of that capital.
